RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, December 7, 2010/Agrahayana 16, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Finance; Health and Family Welfare; Heavy
Industries and Public Enterprises; Panchayati Raj; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Rural Development; Shipping)
Total number of questions—20
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Under five child mortality
*381. SHRI T.M. SELV AGANAPATHI:
Will the Minister of  HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the country
accounted for 21 per cent of under five
child deaths during the year 2009;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that under
five mortality is increasingly concentrated
in a few countries, including India; and
(d)  if so, the details thereof?
Reproductive and Child Health
Programme
*382. SHRIMATI GUNDU
SUDHARANI : Will the Minister of
HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be
pleased to state:
(a) the extent to which the interventions
through Reproductive and Child Health
Programme are helping in improving child
health and addressing mortality and
morbidity of children in the country, with
a particular reference to Andhra Pradesh;
(b) whether any survey, after the
National Family Health Survey-3,
2005-06, has been conducted; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Discovery of natural gas in Khambhat
region of Gujarat
†*383. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of  PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that an Australian
oil exploration company, Oilex Limited, has
discovered abundant reserves of natural gas
in Khambhat region of Gujarat;

120
(b) if so, the total estimated gas reserves
in billion cusec feet in Khambhat Basin;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the gas
reserves adjoining Khambhat city in that
block are as rich as the ones belonging to
Reliance Industries at D-6 block of KG
Basin in the Bay of Bengal; and
(d)  the extent to which the gas reserves
found in Khambhat region would make the
country self-sufficient in terms of natural
gas?
Super-speciality wing in Safdarjung
Hospital, Delhi
*384. PROF. ANIL KUMAR
SAHANI: Will the Minister of  HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether  some  Members  of
Parliament had written to the Minister on
2 February, 2010 regarding the ample space
lying unused in Safdarjung Hospital and
the Minister on 24 September, 2010 replied
that there is a proposal for the construction
of 550 bedded super speciality wing in
Safdarjung Hospital;
(b) if so, whether the super speciality
wing has since been established; and
(c) if not, the reasons for the delay and
by when this wing will be set up?
Construction of roads under PMGSY
in Tamil Nadu
*385. SHRIMATI JAYANTHI
NATARAJAN : Will the Minister of
RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) the total number of habitations
connected and road lengths completed in
Tamil Nadu under the Pradhan Mantri
Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY) during the
last three years, year-wise and district-wise;
(b)  the number of habitations yet to be
covered under PMGSY in the State;
(c) by when all these habitations will be
covered; and
(d)  the steps Government has taken to
ensure the quality of roads constructed
under PMGSY in the State?
Connectivity of Dolphin at T3 in IGI
Airport
*386. SHRI PRAKASH
JA V ADEKAR: Will the Minister of  CIVIL
A VIA TION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is no
Dolphin connectivity in Terminal Three
(T-3) at Indira Gandhi International Airport
(IGIA) in Delhi;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) what steps Government plans to
take to remedy the situation?
Clearance of proposals under
Swajaldhara Programme
in Gujarat
*387. SHRI BHARATSINH
PRABHATSINH PARMAR: W ill the
Minister of  RURAL DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of districts, including
Amreli, Mehsana, Bharuch, Rajkot,
V adodara and Surat, in Gujarat from where
proposals under Swajaldhara Programme
have been received;

121
(b) the reasons for pendency of these
proposals;
(c) whether any time-limit has been fixed
for the clearance of these proposals; and
(d)  whether due to excess time being
taken in clearance of these proposals,
developmental works are being badly
affected?
TFC grant to Rajasthan
†*388. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of  FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) the reasons for non-issuance of
second instalment of Twelfth Finance
Commission (TFC) grant to the State
Government of Rajasthan so far for the
years 2008-09 and 2009-10;
(b) the action plan prepared by the
Central Government in this regard; and
(c) the time by when second instalment
of last two years would be issued to the
State Government and the reasons for such
a long delay?
Submission of data on NRI black
money by foreign countries
*389. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of  FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that several
countries have submitted data on NRI black
money to Government;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action taken to bring back the
black money?
Opening of Asok Paper Mill
*390. SHRI KUMAR DEEPAK DAS:
Will the Minister of  HEA VY INDUSTRIES
AND PUBLIC ENTERPRISES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Asok Paper
Mill in Assam has not been opened even
after 25 years of Assam Accord;
(b) the details of the steps taken to open
the Asok Paper Mill during the last 25 years
of Assam Accord;
(c) whether the Ministry proposes to
open the Asok Paper Mill during the current
financial year; and
(d)  if not, the reasons therefor?
Involvement of senior bank officials
in fake currency racket
*391. SHRI SABIR ALI: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that involvement
of some senior bank officials in the fake
currency racket has been established in the
recent raids conducted in various parts of
the country; and
(b) if so, the details in this regard and
the action taken against them?
Highest bed-patient ratio
*392. SHRI R.C. SINGH: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the country
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

122
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
has the second highest number of hospital
beds in the world;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the bed-
patient ratio is one of the highest in the
world;
(c) if so, whether the hospital beds are
available as per the requirements of
patients; and
(d) if not, how the Ministry is planning
to address the issue scrupulously?
Policy lapses due to termination of
insurance agents
*393. SHRI VIJAY JAW AHARLAL
DARDA: Will the Minister of FINANCE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Insurance
Regulatory and Development Authority
(IRDA), in its Annual Report for 2009,
has indicated phenomenal rate of
termination of 68 per cent, as 8.72 lakh
agents were removed from life insurers rolls;
(b) if so, whether it is a drain on the
resources of insurance companies who
spend about ` 10,000/- on training an
agent;
(c) whether in 2008-09 91 lakh life
insurance policies worth ` 99,542 crores
lapsed, as follow-up of payment of
premiums is done by these agents; and
(d) the measures taken to avoid such
large number of policies from lapsing?
Ill-effects of honey mixed with
antibiotics
*394. DR. BHARATKUMAR RAUT:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that according to
a study carried out by the Centre for Science
and Environment most of the honey brands
available in the market contain varying
amount of antibiotics;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the over
consumption of such branded honey could
induce resistance to antibiotics, leading to
blood-related disorder and injury to the
liver; and
(c) the steps Government intends to
take to stop mixing antibiotics in honey by
the well-known Ayurvedic medicine
producing companies like Dabur, Himalaya,
Patanjali, Baidyanath, Khadi, Gold,
Himflora, Mehsons, Umang, etc.?
Access to safer drinking water in
rural areas
†*395. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that only 30 per
cent dwellers in rural areas of the country
are getting pure and safe water;
(b) if not, the details thereof;
(c) whether the scarcity of this
availability is due to water shortage in the
country;
(d) if not, the reaction of Government
thereto; and
(e) the reasons for non-availability of
pure water to all the dwellers of rural areas?

123
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
New international AI hub
abroad
*396. SHRI K.E. ISMAIL: Will the
Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Air India (AI) proposes to
set up new international hub abroad;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has held
discussions with various countries in the
matter;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) the details of the criteria fixed by
Government for identification of sites for
setting up of such international hubs; and
(f) the details of the facilities likely to
be expected by the Airlines from those
countries?
Inquiry report on Mangalore
air crash
†*397. SHRI SATYA VRAT
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
CIVIL A VIATION be pleased to refer to
reply to Starred Question 10 given in the
Rajya Sabha on 9 November, 2010 and
state:
(a) whether Government has received
the inquiry report on M/s Air India Express
Boeing 737 crash at Mangalore on 22 May,
2010;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether main causes of the accident
were the pilot being in an inebriated
condition and movement of the plane in
wrong direction;
(d) if so, the steps taken to prevent
such accidents in future; and
(e) the steps taken by Government in
this regard and whether pre-flight tests on
pilots are conducted in view of alcoholic
habits in most of the pilots?
Value of currency notes issued in
country
†*398. SHRI NARESH CHANDRA
AGRAWAL: W ill the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) the current value of currency duly
issued by Government in the country and
also norms for printing the currency;
(b) whether it is a fact that printing of
currency against the norms has led to
devaluation of rupee and on the other hand
it has increased black money in the country;
(c) if so, the action taken by Government
thereon; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Demand of old records by Service Tax
Divisions in Delhi
*399. SHRI JAI PRAKASH
NARAYAN SINGH: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that various
Divisions of Commissioner of Service Tax
in Delhi have issued letters to service-tax
payers demanding to submit total gross
amount received and total service-tax paid
etc., for the last four years;
(b) if so, the reasons for seeking such
information when tax payers are filing their
returns;

124
(c) whether seeking such details is
harassment to service-tax payers;
(d) the reasons that officers of service
tax department do not maintain their own
records regularly; and
(e) the steps being taken to stop such
harassment by withdrawing letters seeking
detailed information for the last 4-5 years?
Allocation of gas forum
KG-D6 Basin
*400. SHRI KANJIBHAI PA TEL: Will
the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that based on
recommendation from Group of Ministers,
priority list has been finalized for allocation
of KG D-6 gas for various sectors;
(b) whether Small and Medium
Enterprises (SMEs) have been included in
the priority list;
(c) whether the State Government of
Gujarat has requested the Central
Government to include SMEs in the
priority list; and
(d) if so, the response of Government
thereto?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 1st December, 2010 Secretary-General.
Agrahayana 10, 1932 (Saka)

125
